owner: Agent 2 — free demo vs paid catalog

summary.en: Free = 15 forever demos. Basic = Primary OR Secondary library. Pro = full library. Trial = Pro for 7 days.
summary.zh-HK: 免費＝15 個永久示範。基本＝小學或中學其中一庫。專業＝完整課程庫。試用＝7 日專業權限。

other.notes: Paths outside Primary_School / Secondary_School (e.g. bible_study, typing test) are out of V1 product scope — do not sell or soft-paywall via this catalog.

resolutionOrder: 2. If path is in data/free-demo-catalog.json → ALLOW (reason: free_demo). Works for guests.
3. If path matches outOfScopePrefixes → DENY / hide from product library (V1).
4. If entitlement === all → ALLOW Primary_School and Secondary_School (reason: pro_or_trial).
5. If entitlement === primary and path starts with Primary_School/ → ALLOW.
6. If entitlement === secondary and path starts with Secondary_School/ → ALLOW.
7. Else DENY with soft paywall (reason: subscribe_required | wrong_library_tier).

subscribe_required.en: This module is part of the paid library. Start a free trial or subscribe to unlock.
subscribe_required.zh-HK: 呢個模組屬於付費課程庫。開始免費試用或訂閱即可解鎖。

wrong_library_tier.en: Your Basic plan covers one library (Primary or Secondary). Upgrade to Pro for the full library, or switch library at renewal.
wrong_library_tier.zh-HK: 你嘅基本計劃只包括一個課程庫（小學或中學）。升級專業版可解鎖全部，或於續訂時轉庫。

auth_required.en: Sign in to continue. Free demos stay available without an account.
auth_required.zh-HK: 請登入後繼續。免費示範仍然唔使帳戶都可以玩。

out_of_scope.en: This content is not part of the hksteamai.com V1 library.
out_of_scope.zh-HK: 呢份內容唔屬於 hksteamai.com V1 課程庫。

free_catalog_override.valueShape: JSON string array of extra module folder paths
